FlashGold_NativeReference_Calibrated.note: Calibrated on the tick replay (REPORT.md). Development build: TradingEnabled stays false. Verify in the Strategy Tester (real ticks, execution delay about 150 ms) before anything else.

FlashGold_Micro1s_Calibrated.note: Same changes on the 1 s micro preset. As shipped, the micro filter blocks all entries after 4096 occupied buckets (about 68 minutes) until the EA is restarted; see REPORT.md section 8.

FlashGold_NativeReference_Calibrated_ent.note: Strategy Tester optimisation of the entry inputs around the calibrated preset. Real ticks, execution delay about 150 ms, forward period 1/3.

FlashGold_NativeReference_Calibrated_exi.note: Strategy Tester optimisation of stops, target and both trailing mechanisms around the calibrated preset. InpReferenceSpreadPts sets the trail-layer distance (3.33 x the larger of the live spread and this value).

FlashGold_NativeReference_shipped_traili.note: Strategy Tester optimisation of the simple trailing on the SHIPPED entries, with the burst-settle wait off so that trailing can act at all (as shipped: start 270 is beyond the 180 target and the settle rule needs a 100 pip pullback).
